description: Assign an account (4-8 digits, the user's chart) to whole question groups. For a booking type the answer is stored as a rule for later files unless remember=false: within this job for anonymous jobs, for the client profile's future files with an API key. A revenue account on a group with direction expense (money out) is only usual for refunds or credit notes: ask your user before answering, then pass acknowledge_revenue_on_money_out=true. Without it the answer is applied with a warning in the result (code revenue_on_money_out); an answered question cannot be answered again here. With an API key, corrections are made in the review on konverter-pro.de; in a job without an account they are not possible: upload the file with an API key or use an account.

acknowledge_revenue_on_money_out.description: Your user confirmed a revenue account on money-out bookings (refund, credit note): no warning, remembered on the bookings
